propositions: Open or in-progress bugs with caused_by edges pointing to an epic or its descendants must deterministically block epic close via a DET floor that scans each candidate bug's compiled deps[] for reverse-directional caused_by edges

Candidate bugs for LLM screening are deterministically filtered as open/in_progress bugs linked to the epic subtree (any relation, any depth, both directions) OR created after the epic's first open->in_progress status transition, capped at 32 with overflow tallied

Haiku relevance screen evaluates each filtered candidate via a forced-choice verdict (A=defect-in-deliverable, B=pre-existing/adjacent, C=unrelated) using trivial-class model, rides model-class config with prompt caching, and forwards at most 8 compact A-verdicts plus overflow count into the verifier's fenced context

Verifier adjudication blocks only undispositioned defect-in-deliverable candidates, where disposition is satisfied via store-grounded signals: (a) supersedes/duplicates link to epic subtree or successor, or (b) reasoned pre-existence/deferral prose in description/comments (bare 'out of scope' does not qualify)
Screen tally including per-bug verdict and overflow count is recorded in completion sidecar; screen execution failure degrades to open with logged reason rather than blocking the close

DET floor, candidate filter, and screen together replace direct-children-only gate to catch linked and unlinked bugs filed outside epic hierarchy during execution while protecting legitimate deferrals via disposition adjudication on store-grounded evidence
